subject: Future Tech
title: AI Agents and Tool Use
description: A micro-lesson that makes AI Agents and Tool Use usable.

hook.text: An AI agent doesn't answer questions.

buildup.text: Early AI was passive: ask a question, get an answer. Agents are active: given a goal, they plan, execute, and iterate.

discovery.text: Agents use LLMs as the brain, connected to tools: calculators, search engines, code interpreters, and APIs.

twist.text: Agents often fail at complex tasks.

climax.text: Improving agent reliability is a key AGI prerequisite.

punchline.text: From answering to doing. Agents are AI with hands.

quiz.question: What makes AI agents different from standard chatbots?
options: They actively plan, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks
